Bin map

Every point is one {{BIN_SIZE_HUMAN}} bin, placed by the k-mer vocabulary it uses and nothing else. Neighbouring points share words, not coordinates.

Key

    Genome ribbon

    The same bins, back in genomic order along {{RIBBON_SUBJECT}}, painted with the same colours. Select points above to find them here; drag or click a stretch here to find it above.

    Click a painted stretch to select the whole contiguous run of that colour · drag a box to select an interval.

    Cluster × feature enrichment

    log2 of (fraction of the cluster's bins carrying a feature) over (fraction genome-wide). Warm means the cluster is made of that feature; cool means it systematically avoids it. Rows are ordered by cluster size.
